top_critical.title: SAP Commerce Cloud CVE-2026-58231: Critical RCE Flaw
top_critical.summary: SAP has patched a maximum-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-58231, CVSS 10.0) in Commerce Cloud's Data Hub Adapter that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. The flaw stems from i
top_critical.architects_take: Apply SAP's patch immediately — a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE with no prerequisite access is as bad as it gets. Until patched, consider placing WAF rules or network-level controls in front of the Data Hub Adapter endpoint to restrict access to trusted IP ranges only.
